name: Windward Bio Group AG
summary: Windward Bio Group AG operates as a clinical stage biotechnology company that develops ultra-long-acting antibody medicines for patients with respiratory and dermatologic diseases. Its drug candidates WIN378, an ultra-long-acting and novel fully human monoclonal antibody, which has completed Phase I clinical study that inhibits thymic stromal lymphopoietin (TSLP); and WIN027, an ultra-long-acting bispecific antibody that is in Phase I clinical study simultaneously targets TSLP and interleukin-13 (IL-13) and two clinically validated drivers of inflammatory disease.
